findings.detail: Requiring every product branch to update the shared queue serialised otherwise independent work.
findings.reason: Approval rows now land on main first; planner/integrator queue commits are separate from development branches.

findings.detail: Using the public approval queue as live claim state would create a second operational authority.
findings.reason: The queue explicitly does not mirror live claim or lease state; it owns approval/integration state only.

findings.detail: Historical delivered rows do not carry branch/write_scope fields.
findings.reason: The contract applies to new queued/ready/in_progress rows; rewriting delivered history would fabricate fields that were not recorded at the time.
